description: This file defines the ExecutionContext class in the Drupal core validation system, implementing the ExecutionContextInterface. It manages validation violations, current validation state, and related metadata within the Drupal validation framework.

classes.name: ExecutionContext
classes.description: Implements validation execution context, managing violations, validation state, and metadata for Drupal validation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the execution context with validator, root object, translator, and optional translation domain.

methods.name: setNode
methods.description: Sets the current node's value, object, metadata, and property path.

methods.name: setConstraint
methods.description: Sets the current validation constraint.

methods.name: addViolation
methods.description: Adds a validation violation message to the violations list.

methods.name: buildViolation
methods.description: Creates a new violation builder for constructing complex violation messages.

methods.name: getViolations
methods.description: Returns the list of violations accumulated in the current context.

methods.name: getValidator
methods.description: Returns the validator instance.

methods.name: getRoot
methods.description: Returns the root object being validated.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the current value under validation.

methods.name: getObject
methods.description: Returns the object currently validated.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Returns the validation metadata.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Returns the current validation group.

methods.name: setGroup
methods.description: Sets the validation group.

methods.name: getClassName
methods.description: Returns the class name of the validated object.

methods.name: getPropertyName
methods.description: Returns the property name being validated.

methods.name: getPropertyPath
methods.description: Returns the full property path, optionally appending a subpath.

methods.name: markConstraintAsValidated
methods.description: Marks a constraint as validated for caching purposes.

methods.name: isConstraintValidated
methods.description: Checks if a constraint has already been validated.

methods.name: markGroupAsValidated
methods.description: Marks a validation group as validated.

methods.name: isGroupValidated
methods.description: Checks if a validation group has been validated.

methods.name: markObjectAsInitialized
methods.description: Unsupported method, throws exception.

methods.name: isObjectInitialized
methods.description: Unsupported method, throws exception.

methods.name: __clone
methods.description: Clones the context, including the violations list.

methods.name: getConstraint
methods.description: Returns the current constraint, used internally.
